name: Polar sea ice
summary: Arctic sea ice 1.66M km² and Antarctic 1.56M km² below average on 5 Nov
state: On 5 Nov Arctic sea-ice extent was 8.31 million km², about 1.66 million below the 1981–2010 average and fourth-lowest for the date; Antarctic extent was about 1.56 million below, third-lowest (NSIDC). Both are in the Watch band; neither pole is at a record low for the date.
for_you: Low sea ice amplifies polar warming and can affect weather patterns in the northern hemisphere over the winter.
rubric_hit: Arctic -1.66M km² < -1.0M Watch line; no record low
why: Sea ice reflects sunlight and regulates ocean circulation; record lows accelerate warming.
drivers: Air and ocean temperatures, winds, season.

rubric.alert: Either pole at a record low for the calendar date.
rubric.normal: Arctic and Antarctic extent anomalies both above −1.0 million km² vs 1981–2010.
